SEPTEMBER 13 · 18TH BIRTHDAY

Happy 18th Birthday, Frances

Eighteen. Ang weird isipin na nasa point ka na ngayon where you're officially stepping into another chapter of your life. Parang kailan lang, we were just talking about random things, laughing at stupid stuff, ranting about life, and now here you are, turning 18 naa.

I know your birthday hasn't always been something you look forward to the way other people might. Kaya this year, I really hope you get to experience your birthday differently.

I hope you realize how many people are genuinely happy that you're here.
And I hope you realize that I'm one of them.

one of my favorites of us
random day, good memory
tap a photo to flip it

nigger

Those things mean more to me than you probably realize.

And now that you're 18, I hope you take this new chapter as a chance to choose yourself more. Do the things that make you happy. Go places you've always wanted to go. Meet people who make you feel safe and appreciated. Take chances. Make mistakes. Learn from them. Grow at your own pace.

You don't have to have everything figured out just because you're 18.
You're allowed to still be confused.
You're allowed to not know what comes next.
You're allowed to change your mind.
You're allowed to grow into whoever you want to become.

And through all of that, I hope you never forget how much you're worth. I hope you get the kind of happiness that doesn't feel temporary. The kind where you can genuinely say, "I'm happy to be here." Because you deserve that.

And if one day you look back at your 18th birthday, I hope you don't remember it as just another birthday. I hope you remember it as the beginning of a chapter where you started realizing that you are more loved and appreciated than you thought.

Thank you for being part of my life, Frances. Thank you for the memories, the conversations, the laughs, the rants, and even the moments that weren't easy. I'm still grateful for all of them because they're pieces of a friendship that I'll always be thankful for.

I don't know where life is going to take us from here. Maybe things will change. Maybe we'll get busier. Maybe we'll meet new people and make completely different memories. But I hope that somewhere in your memories of this part of your life, you'll remember me as someone who genuinely wanted you to be happy.

So today, please let yourself be celebrated.
Enjoy your day. Smile a lot. Take too many pictures. Eat good food. Laugh as much as you can. And make a memory worth keeping.

HAPPY HAPPYY 18th birthday, Erin!!

Welcome to a new chapter. I hope it's your best one yet.

And whenever you look back at this letter, I hope you remember one thing: I'm really, really glad you're here.

— Basty
